# E155 Labs

## [Lab 1: FPGA and MCU Testing and Setup](labs/lab1/e155-lab1.qmd)
Lab 1 prompts the assembly of an iCE40 UP5K FPGA development board to house a UPduino v3.1 MCU. Proper board functionality is confirmed through a 7-segment LED display script written in Verilog.
